name: tree-sitter-fsl
description: Tree-sitter grammar for FSL editor and language-server integrations.
author: Thoriq Akbar

scripts.check: npm run lint && npm run build
scripts.format: biome format --write biome.json grammar.js grammar.test.mjs bindings/node/index.js package.json tree-sitter.json
scripts.lint: biome check biome.json grammar.js grammar.test.mjs bindings/node/index.js package.json tree-sitter.json
